projects.title: Multimodal conditional inference
projects.text: One observation can admit multiple plausible parameter solutions. I use residual multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) with conditional Gaussian mixture models (cGMMs) in PyTorch to represent these alternatives in crystal-field inference from magnetic susceptibility. I check physical compatibility through forward reconstruction, study robustness to synthetic noise, intensity scaling, and background offsets, and evaluate predictions on experimental measurements.

projects.title: Robustness in inverse prediction
projects.text: I train MLP and ResNet conditional Gaussian mixtures to infer exchange parameters from high-dimensional, powder-averaged neutron-scattering maps. Exact Sunny forward calculations evaluate whether predicted parameters reproduce the maps, with classical fits as references. Controlled noise, intensity-scale, and background shifts in simulated data test robustness relevant to future experimental transfer.

projects.title: Neural models and Monte Carlo
projects.text: I implement neural-network backflow wavefunctions and variational Monte Carlo (VMC) in JAX for lattice Hubbard models of correlated fermions. This research engineering work covers GPU/multi-GPU sampling, local-energy evaluation, global reductions, and gradient synchronization. I profile runtime and check numerical correctness against reference computations.
